name: Dr. Ana Whitlock, DDS
bio: Ana opened Linden in 2016 after nine years in a busy downtown group practice where appointments ran on a fifteen-minute clock. She wanted the opposite: longer slots, fewer patients a day, and time to explain things.
outside: Sellwood Park on weekends with her two kids and a very slow beagle.

name: Dr. Marcus Oyelaran, DMD
bio: Marcus handles most of our fillings, crowns and emergency visits. Patients tell us he narrates everything he does, which is on purpose. He trained at OHSU and has been with Linden since 2019.
outside: Coaches a Saturday-afternoon youth soccer team in Westmoreland.

name: Danielle Okafor, RDH
bio: Danielle does most of our cleanings and nearly all of our first visits with kids. She is the reason a lot of four-year-olds ask to come back.
outside: Bakes sourdough badly and keeps trying anyway.

name: June Halvorsen
bio: June runs the front desk, insurance paperwork and the schedule. If you call us, she is who answers, and she will tell you the price before you book.
outside: Grows far too many tomatoes for one household.
